ERROR_STATUS

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x8
Size:
0x4

Description

Sticky error flags, W1C. Hardware events win over W1C. Preserved across command SOFT_RESET.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:4] - - - -
[3] CMD_ERR rw, woclr 0x0 -
[2] CFG_ERR rw, woclr 0x0 -
[1] WRITE_ERR rw, woclr 0x0 -
[0] READ_ERR rw, woclr 0x0 -

Field Descriptions

CMD_ERR

Command rejected: illegal sequence (START without weights, LOAD/START while busy, ARRAY_EN=0, LOAD+START together, any command during flush).

CFG_ERR

Command rejected: ACT_COUNT==0 or misaligned base address.

WRITE_ERR

Memory write response carried an error.

READ_ERR

Memory read response carried an error.
